## Parental OpControl 0.15.2

- Websites: every blocked row now has Allow, and a category block shows "Allow (exception)"; Unblock only appears when there is a rule to remove.
- Websites: the add box can Block (always or during a schedule) or Allow a typed domain.
- Websites: the Allowed always list says which category each exception overrides ("Overrides: Social media").
- Websites: allowing a domain that belongs to a known service (WhatsApp, YouTube, Discord and others) offers that service's other domains with unticked checkboxes; nothing is added without the parent ticking it.
- Websites: the Review panel Allow now refreshes the panel, shows a result and logs the action; Unblock is hidden for category-only blocks.
- Rule actions in Websites and Apps show a short success toast or the error text, and the server logs the parent, child and domain.
- Installed apps: NUL and other control characters from registry, Appx/MSIX and file-version strings are removed on the device and again on the server, so one bad app can no longer fail the whole inventory upload. A bad row is logged with the app and device and the rest are saved.
- Visits, usage, block events, tamper events and device messages are sanitized the same way.
- English and es-MX strings for all new screens.
